articles.title: UN biodiversity summit to take stock of 2030 goals
articles.summary: Representatives from 196 countries are meeting in Yerevan to evaluate biodiversity progress under the 2030 targets. The Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework aims to restore ecosystems and phase out harmful subsidies. India's national report highlights progress with key wildlife species, despite challenges in land degradation and protected areas. The report shows India's successful ecosystem restoration and involvement in biodiversity-inclusive planning.

articles.title: Protesters voice concerns across India regarding recent agricultural legislation
articles.summary: Demonstrators gathered across India to share their perspectives and voice concerns regarding recent agricultural legislation known as the farm bills. The ongoing protests highlight significant economic and political tensions within the nation. Agricultural leaders and citizens continue to demand legislative changes to protect their livelihoods, prompting widespread national debate over the future of farming.

articles.title: Malaysia pledges stronger ASEAN security cooperation as regional meeting concludes
articles.summary: MANILA, Philippines (MNTV) – Malaysia reaffirmed its commitment to strengthening security cooperation among Southeast Asian nations following a regional ministerial meeting in the Philippines on transnational crime. Home Minister Saifuddin Nasution Ismail said Thursday that closer ties and mutual understanding among ASEAN member states were essential to maintaining regional peace and stability, the Malaysian National News Agency (Bernama) reported.

articles.title: After Sela Pass, Traffic Congestion Reported at Bumla Pass
articles.summary: TAWANG- A long queue of vehicles was witnessed at Bumla Pass on October 21, causing traffic congestion along the mountainous route in Arunachal Pradesh, a day after heavy traffic was reported at Sela Pass on October 20. The latest congestion highlights the traffic management challenges on high-altitude roads around Tawang, a popular destination for tourists visiting the eastern Himalayas.
articles.title_hi: सेला दर्रे के बाद, बुमला दर्रे पर यातायात भीड़ की सूचना मिली

articles.title: Why Strategic Interests Shield India from Western Pressure
articles.summary: Their renewed engagement illustrates how strategic interests can limit the diplomatic consequences of serious disputes. India's economic importance, military capabilities and position in the Indo-Pacific give Western governments compelling reasons to preserve their relationships with New Delhi. For Washington, India is an important partner in managing China's expanding regional influence.
articles.title_hi: सामरिक हित भारत को पश्चिमी दबाव से क्यों बचाते हैं?

articles.title: Friday taken away: Uttarakhand ends Madrasas' Jumu'ah holiday, forces Sunday break
articles.summary: Uttarakhand has scrapped the Friday holiday at recognised madrasas and moved their weekly break to Sunday, a step critics see as targeting minority institutions after the state abolished its Madrasa Board. Uttarakhand has ended the long-standing Friday holiday at madrasas recognised as schools, replacing it with the regular Sunday weekly break under a new framework for minority educational institutions.

articles.title: Mission Shakti: How UP is expanding women's safety network
articles.summary: Uttar Pradesh's Mission Shakti has grown from a Navratri-linked awareness campaign launched in October 2020 into a wider programme covering police stations, public spaces, educational institutions, urban areas and villages across the state. It focuses on women's safety, dignity and empowerment through policing, public outreach and access to support services.

articles.title: To Regulate or Not to Regulate: India's AI Dilemma
articles.summary: India's shifting position on AI regulation reflects the challenge of balancing innovation with safety. The proposed consultation provides an opportunity to clarify India's regulatory approach. articles.summary_hi: इलिनोइस डेमोक्रेट ने एक्स पर नफरत भरे पोस्टों में 240% बढ़ोतरी का हवाला दिया; 105 सांसदों ने अरोरा हिंदू मंदिर में गोलीबारी के प्रयास की एफबीआई जांच का आग्रह किया है। अमेरिकी कांग्रेसी राजा कृष्णमूर्ति ने सोशल मीडिया पर भारत विरोधी, दक्षिण एशियाई विरोधी और हिंदू विरोधी नफरत में तेज वृद्धि को चिह्नित किया है, प्रमुख प्रौद्योगिकी कंपनियों पर ऑनलाइन नफरत से लाभ कमाने का आरोप लगाया है और कांग्रेस से उन्हें जवाबदेह ठहराने का आह्वान किया है।
articles.title_hinglish: 'bharata virodhi napharata phaila rahi hai aura biga teka munapha kama rahi hai': raja krishnamurti ka aagraha
articles.summary_hinglish: ilinoisa demokreta ne eksa para napharata bhare poston men 240% badhaोtari ka havala diy; 105 sansadon ne arora hindu mandira men golibari ke prayasa ki ephabiaaee jancha ka aagraha kiya hai। ameriki kangresi raja krishnamurti ne soshala midiya para bharata virodhi, dakshina eshiyaee virodhi aura hindu virodhi napharata men teja vriddhi ko chihnita kiya hai, pramukha praudyogiki kanpaniyon para ऑnalaina napharata se labha kamane ka aaropa lagaya hai aura kangresa se unhen javabadeha thaharane ka aahvana kiya hai।

articles.title: India's AI financing demand to shift towards data centres, but GPU, regulatory risks
articles.summary: India’s AI market is expected to see a shift in demand towards debt financing for data centres and computing infrastructure. At the same time, the sector faces several risks, including the rapid obsoleteness of graphics processing units (GPUs), uncertain revenue models and evolving governance regulations, as per a report by Union Bank of India.

articles.title: Weather Today, October 20: Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Kerala & Karnataka on rain alert; IMD
articles.summary: Weather Today, October 20 (Google Trends): The IMD has forecast heavy rainfall across Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka and parts of Andhra Pradesh from October 20 onwards. Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal may receive isolated very heavy rainfall till October 21, while Kerala is likely to see heavy rain till October 25.

articles.summary_hi: मौसम आज, 20 अक्टूबर (Google रुझान): आईएमडी ने 20 अक्टूबर से तमिलनाडु, केरल, कर्नाटक और आंध्र प्रदेश के कुछ हिस्सों में भारी वर्षा की भविष्यवाणी की है। तमिलनाडु, पुडुचेरी और कराईकल में 21 अक्टूबर तक बहुत भारी बारिश हो सकती है, जबकि केरल में 25 अक्टूबर तक भारी बारिश होने की संभावना है।
articles.title_hinglish: mausama aaj, 20 aktubar: tamilanadu, puducheri, kerala aura karnataka men barisha ka alart; aaeeemadi
articles.summary_hinglish: mausama aaj, 20 aktubara (Google rujhana): aaeeemadi ne 20 aktubara se tamilanadu, keral, karnataka aura aandhra pradesha ke kuchha hisson men bhari varsha ki bhavishyavani ki hai। tamilanadu, puducheri aura karaeekala men 21 aktubara taka bahuta bhari barisha ho sakati hai, jabaki kerala men 25 aktubara taka bhari barisha hone ki sanbhavana hai।

articles.title: 'India-based' D-Company tag: New Delhi rebukes UN rapporteur, flags 'glaring inaccuracies'
articles.summary: India has pushed back against a United Nations special rapporteur’s description of fugitive gangster Dawood Ibrahim’s D-Company as an “India-based” criminal group, flagging “glaring inaccuracies” in a counter-terrorism report. India warned that such factual errors, coupled with a lack of accountability for UN experts, risk undermining the credibility of the world body.
articles.title_hi: 'भारत स्थित' डी-कंपनी का टैग: नई दिल्ली ने संयुक्त राष्ट्र के दूत को फटकार लगाई, 'गंभीर अशुद्धियाँ' बताईं
articles.summary_hi: भारत ने संयुक्त राष्ट्र के विशेष प्रतिवेदक द्वारा भगोड़े गैंगस्टर दाऊद इब्राहिम की डी-कंपनी को "भारत-आधारित" आपराधिक समूह के रूप में वर्णित किए जाने का विरोध किया है और आतंकवाद विरोधी रिपोर्ट में "स्पष्ट अशुद्धियों" को उजागर किया है। भारत ने चेतावनी दी कि इस तरह की तथ्यात्मक त्रुटियां, संयुक्त राष्ट्र विशेषज्ञों के लिए जवाबदेही की कमी के साथ, विश्व निकाय की विश्वसनीयता को कम करने का जोखिम उठाती हैं।
articles.title_hinglish: 'bharata sthita' di-kanpani ka taig: naee dilli ne sanyukta rashtra ke duta ko phatakara lagaee, 'ganbhira ashuddhiyan' bataeen
articles.summary_hinglish: bharata ne sanyukta rashtra ke vishesha prativedaka dvara bhagodaे gaingastara daooda ibrahima ki di-kanpani ko "bharata-aadharita" aaparadhika samuha ke rupa men varnita kie jane ka virodha kiya hai aura aatankavada virodhi riporta men "spashta ashuddhiyon" ko ujagara kiya hai। bharata ne chetavani di ki isa taraha ki tathyatmaka trutiyan, sanyukta rashtra visheshajnyon ke lie javabadehi ki kami ke sath, vishva nikaya ki vishvasaniyata ko kama karane ka jokhima uthati hain।

articles.title: US Postal Service releases new Diwali postage stamp featuring Indian artist's rangoli art
articles.summary: The US Postal Service has introduced a new postage stamp to commemorate the festival of Diwali. This stamp features a beautiful rangoli design created by Sangita Bhutada, an artist based in Houston. The stamp was unveiled at a ceremony attended by India's Ambassador to the US, Vinay Mohan Kwatra, and USPS officials.
articles.title_hi: अमेरिकी डाक सेवा ने भारतीय कलाकारों की रंगोली कला को दर्शाने वाला नया दिवाली डाक टिकट जारी किया

articles.title_hinglish: ameriki daka seva ne bharatiya kalakaron ki rangoli kala ko darshane vala naya divali daka tikata jari kiya
articles.summary_hinglish: ameriki daka seva ne divali ke tyohara ke upalakshya men eka naya daka tikata pesha kiya hai। isa daka tikata men hyustana sthita kalakara sangita bhutada dvara banaee gaee eka sundara rangoli dijaाina hai। isa daka tikata ka anavarana eka samaroha men kiya gaya jisamen amerika men bharata ke rajaduta vinaya mohana kvatra aura yuesapiesa adhikari shamila hue।

articles.title: RBL Bank evaluates broking, MF foray as part of expanding capital market activities
articles.summary: Making it clear that no decision has been reached on the subject, its managing director and chief executive R Subramaniakumar said the bank, a subsidiary of UAE’s Emirates NBD, will see which activities can be done internally, which can be handled at the group level and the separate units which it needs to form.

articles.title_hinglish: ilektroniksa aura aaeeti ke lie vishveshvaraiya piechadi yojana (2014): nirmana ke lie bharata ke prayason ka aakalana
articles.summary_hinglish: isa yojana ka uddeshya ilektroniksa sistama dijaina aura vinirmana (eeesadiema) aura suchana praudyogiki/suchana praudyogiki-sakshama sevaon (aaeeti/aaeetieeesa) men piechadi ke satha yogya peshevaron ki sankhya ko badhaाva dena hai। isaka uddeshya yuva shodhakartaon ko vishesha rupa se sthapita phaेloshipa ke satha ina kshetron men aakarshita karana aura banae rakhana bhi tha। yojana ka nama sara em. rakha gaya।

The court emphasized that they must adhere to the specified conditions in their bonds. Delhi Police Crime Branch summons CJP leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka to its Rajouri Garden office on Thursday. One company, 2 words.
articles.title_hi: दिल्ली पुलिस की अपराध शाखा ने सीजेपी नेता सौरव दास, आशुतोष रांका को राजौरी गार्डन बुलाया

articles.title_hinglish: dilli pulisa ki aparadha shakha ne sijepi neta saurava das, aashutosha ranka ko rajauri gardana bulaya
articles.summary_hinglish: unhonne puchhatachha samapta hone taka shanti banae rakhane ke lie 50,000 rupaye ke vyaktigata aura jamanata banda pradana kie। adalata ne isa bata para jora diya ki unhen apane banda men nirdishta sharton ka palana karana hoga। dilli pulisa ki aparadha shakha ne sijepi neta saurava dasa aura aashutosha ranka ko guruvara ko apane rajauri gardana karyalaya men bulaya। eka kanpani, do shabd.

articles.title: Shiv Sena defends public protests against Modi government as democratic
articles.summary: On Thursday, the Shiv Sena Uddhav Balasaheb Thackeray party defended public protests against the government as democratic dissent. An editorial in its mouthpiece criticised remarks by Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh chief Mohan Bhagwat linking agitations to instability. The party argued that public mobilisation holds leaders accountable and is essential for addressing grievances involving inflation, unemployment, and governance failures.
articles.title_hi: शिवसेना मोदी सरकार के खिलाफ जनता के विरोध प्रदर्शन को लोकतांत्रिक बताती है
articles.summary_hi: गुरुवार को, शिवसेना उद्धव बालासाहेब ठाकरे पार्टी ने सरकार के खिलाफ सार्वजनिक विरोध प्रदर्शन को लोकतांत्रिक असहमति के रूप में बचाव किया। इसके मुखपत्र के एक संपादकीय में राष्ट्रीय स्वयंसेवक संघ प्रमुख मोहन भागवत द्वारा आंदोलनों को अस्थिरता से जोड़ने वाली टिप्पणी की आलोचना की गई है। पार्टी ने तर्क दिया कि सार्वजनिक लामबंदी नेताओं को जवाबदेह बनाती है और मुद्रास्फीति, बेरोजगारी और शासन की विफलताओं से संबंधित शिकायतों के समाधान के लिए आवश्यक है।
articles.title_hinglish: shivasena modi sarakara ke khilapha janata ke virodha pradarshana ko lokatantrika batati hai
articles.summary_hinglish: guruvara ko, shivasena uddhava balasaheba thakare parti ne sarakara ke khilapha sarvajanika virodha pradarshana ko lokatantrika asahamati ke rupa men bachava kiya। isake mukhapatra ke eka sanpadakiya men rashtriya svayansevaka sangha pramukha mohana bhagavata dvara aandolanon ko asthirata se jodane vali tippani ki aalochana ki gaee hai। parti ne tarka diya ki sarvajanika lamabandi netaon ko javabadeha banati hai aura mudrasphiti, berojagari aura shasana ki viphalataon se sanbandhita shikayaton ke samadhana ke lie aavashyaka hai।

articles.title: Voting begins for first phase of Rajasthan local body polls across 16 districts
articles.summary: Polling began at 7 am on Thursday in the first phase of Rajasthan’s three-phase Panchayati Raj elections, with more than 85 lakh voters eligible to elect representatives to 16 zila parishads and 104 panchayat samitis across 16 districts. A total of 6,976 candidates are contesting 2,081 seats in this phase, including 293 zila parishad wards and 1,788 panchayat samiti wards.
articles.title_hi: राजस्थान के 16 जिलों में स्थानीय निकाय चुनाव के पहले चरण के लिए मतदान शुरू हो गया है
articles.summary_hi: राजस्थान के तीन चरण के पंचायती राज चुनावों के पहले चरण में गुरुवार सुबह 7 बजे मतदान शुरू हुआ, जिसमें 16 जिलों में 16 जिला परिषदों और 104 पंचायत समितियों के प्रतिनिधियों का चुनाव करने के लिए 85 लाख से अधिक मतदाता पात्र थे। इस चरण में कुल 6,976 उम्मीदवार 2,081 सीटों पर चुनाव लड़ रहे हैं, जिनमें 293 जिला परिषद वार्ड और 1,788 पंचायत समिति वार्ड शामिल हैं।
articles.title_hinglish: rajasthana ke 16 jilon men sthaniya nikaya chunava ke pahale charana ke lie matadana shuru ho gaya hai
articles.summary_hinglish: rajasthana ke tina charana ke panchayati raja chunavon ke pahale charana men guruvara subaha 7 baje matadana shuru hua, jisamen 16 jilon men 16 jila parishadon aura 104 panchayata samitiyon ke pratinidhiyon ka chunava karane ke lie 85 lakha se adhika matadata patra the। isa charana men kula 6,976 ummidavara 2,081 siton para chunava lada rahe hain, jinamen 293 jila parishada varda aura 1,788 panchayata samiti varda shamila hain।

articles.title: News 18 Marathi Headlines | 22 OCT | 10 AM | Devendra Fadnavis
articles.summary: News 18 Marathi Headlines | मुंबईतील तीन बहुप्रतीक्षित पुलांचे लोकार्पण मुख्यमंत्री आणि उपमुख्यमंत्र्यांच्या हस्ते होणार आहे. सायन रेल्वे उड्डाणपूल, विद्याविहार पूल आणि गोरेगाव-मुलुंड लिंक रोड या प्रकल्पांच्या उद्घाटनाकडे मुंबईकरांचे लक्ष लागले आहे. articles.title: Gujarat issues new school entry rules, makes principal's written permission mandatory
articles.summary: Only government officials duly authorised to perform their official duties will be exempt from the requirement of obtaining prior written permission. The circular emphasises that the state government has a special responsibility towards children studying in government schools under the principle of “In Loco Parentis”, which means acting in the place of a parent.

articles.summary_hinglish: kevala apane aadhikarika kartavyon ka palana karane ke lie vidhivata adhikrita sarakari adhikariyon ko purva likhita anumati prapta karane ki aavashyakata se chhuta di jaegi। paripatra men isa bata para jora diya gaya hai ki ina loko perentisa siddhanta ke tahata sarakari skulon men padhane vale bachchon ke prati rajya sarakara ki vishesha jimmedari hai, jisaka artha hai mata-pita ke sthana para karya karana।

articles.title: Millions of Children of Incarcerated Parents Face Severe Institutional Neglect
articles.summary: Criminal convictions in India disproportionately harm millions of dependent children who endure poverty and social stigma. Official data reveals a massive prison population lacking systemic tracking for these vulnerable minors.
